## Summary
Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Scope
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI

## Validation evidence
List commands/tests run and their results. Do not claim checks that were not executed.

## Risk and compatibility
Describe behavior, API, database, migration, and security impact.

## Operational notes
Describe configuration, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and recovery implications.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests and fixtures added/updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No secrets or production data committed
- [ ] Authorization and input validation reviewed
- [ ] Generated output is traceable and reproducible
- [ ] Failure/unsupported cases are visible
